# Georgia Public Safety Training Center (GPSTC)

> > Georgia's premier training institution for law enforcement, firefighting, and public safety careers, offering POST-certified programs and continuing education.

GPSTC provides comprehensive basic training, certification programs, and online education for aspiring and current public safety professionals across Georgia. The center operates multiple regional locations and maintains rigorous training standards through POST certification.

## Key Topics

- POST Certification
- Basic Law Enforcement Training
- Basic Firefighter Training
- Jail Officer Training
- Communications Officer Training
- Public Safety Careers
- Law Enforcement
- Fire and Emergency Services
- Continuing Education
- Georgia Peace Officer Standards and Training
- Training Requirements
- Forsyth Campus
- Regional Academies
- Career Pathways
- Online Training

## Getting Started in Public Safety

- [Careers in Public Safety](https://www.gpstc.org/careers-in-public-safety): Overview of public safety career paths including law enforcement, firefighting, and support roles
- [Become a Police Officer](https://www.gpstc.org/careers-in-public-safety/become-a-police-officer): Guide to becoming a Georgia police officer through GPSTC Basic Law Enforcement Training
- [Become a Firefighter](https://www.gpstc.org/careers-in-public-safety/become-a-firefighter): Guide to becoming a firefighter through GPSTC Basic Firefighter Training Program
- [Become a Jail Officer](https://www.gpstc.org/careers-in-public-safety/become-a-jail-officer): Guide to becoming a jail officer through POST-certified Basic Jail Officer Training
- [Become a Communications Officer](https://www.gpstc.org/careers-in-public-safety/become-a-communications-officer): Guide to becoming a communications officer through 40-hour POST-certified training
- [Physical Agility Testing Schedule](https://www.gpstc.org/careers-in-public-safety/become-a-police-officer/physical-agility-testing-schedule): Schedule and locations for POST physical agility testing for police officer candidates

## Training Programs & Courses

- [Training at GPSTC](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc): Overview of GPSTC training programs for law enforcement and fire/emergency services
- [Basic Training](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/basic-training): Overview of basic training programs for law enforcement, firefighters, and support roles
- [Certification Programs](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/certification-programs): Law enforcement, firefighter, and instructor certification programs offered by GPSTC
- [Online Training](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/online-training): Online and blended learning courses for POST-certified continuing education requirements
- [View Courses](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/view-courses): Course catalog for law enforcement and fire service training certification programs

## Student Resources & Support

- [Student Access](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/student-access): Student portal for account access, registration, transcripts, and certificate printing
- [Office of the Registrar](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/office-of-the-registrar): Registrar office for enrollment, transcripts, policies, and student eligibility information
- [Training Policies](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/training-policies): GPSTC training policies covering attendance, conduct, registration, and disciplinary rules

## Locations & Facilities

- [Locations](https://www.gpstc.org/locations): GPSTC regional training center locations with contact information and program offerings
- [Training Bureau](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/training-bureau): Training Bureau directory with staff contacts and academy program information

## Optional: Campus Resources

- [Academic Complex](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/academic-building): Overview of Forsyth campus Academic Complex facilities and student amenities
- [Training Complexes](https://www.gpstc.org/training-at-gpstc/training-complexes): Description of Forsyth campus training complexes for firefighting, driving, and firearms
- [Employment at GPSTC](https://www.gpstc.org/about-gpstc/employment-at-gpstc): Job openings and employment opportunities for trainers and staff at GPSTC locations
